description:
The state, local, and education (SLED) market is made up of government business opportunities worth $1.5 trillion. With spending on the rise and opportunities in abundance in many states and localities, businesses are using tools like GovWin IQ to take advantage and develop their public sector sales strategies. 
GovWin IQ supports vendors involved in state and local government contracting by enabling them to identify projects well before the bid or RFP is released, pursue deals faster with data-backed confidence, and plan strategically to compete and win in the SLED market.

labeler.rationale: The service provides project and contracting-opportunity information to help vendors identify opportunities, pursue deals, and plan sales strategies, conventional market intelligence and planning.
evidence_spans: enabling them to identify projects well before the bid or RFP is released, pursue deals faster with data-backed confidence, and plan strategically to compete and win

blind.rationale: The product supports vendors with identifying government projects before bids, pursuing deals using data, and planning sales strategies—conventional market research and sales-planning functions.
evidence_spans: enabling them to identify projects well before the bid or RFP is released, pursue deals faster with data-backed confidence, and plan strategically to compete and win in the SLED market.

parent_concerns: Identify projects before bids and win/pursue deals faster are desired outcomes. Proposals infer market-research/information-service operations; source does not explain identification mechanism. Assess concrete described conventional functionality vs benefit/category only.

description: Anaplan is the leading planning and performance management platform for smart businesses.  Anaplan combines an unrivaled planning and modeling engine, predictive analytics, and cloud collaboration into one simple interface for business users.

labeler.rationale: The text describes planning, modeling, and cloud collaboration as conventional business functions, but its mention of predictive analytics leaves implementation ambiguous; best-supported judgment is non-AI, forced.
evidence_spans: planning and modeling engine, predictive analytics, and cloud collaboration

blind.rationale: Planning and modeling, performance management and cloud collaboration are conventional functions, but the mention of predictive analytics is ambiguous about whether it uses AI; absent an affirmative AI claim, the best-supported binary choice is non_ai with uncertainty.
evidence_spans: planning and modeling engine, predictive analytics, and cloud collaboration

description: Provides enterprise software solutions. The Company develops, supports, and maintains budgeting, project, asset, depreciation, lease, property tax, and income tax software solutions.

labeler.rationale: The described software handles budgeting, project, asset, depreciation, lease, property-tax, and income-tax processes, conventional enterprise administration.
evidence_spans: budgeting, project, asset, depreciation, lease, property tax, and income tax software solutions.

blind.rationale: It specifies budgeting, project, asset, depreciation, lease, property-tax and income-tax software, conventional financial and administrative functions without an AI signal.
evidence_spans: budgeting, project, asset, depreciation, lease, property tax, and income tax software solutions.

parent_concerns: Source lists categories of software developed/supported/maintained, not what the software does. Both rationales infer handling these processes. Distinguish vendor software-category list from concrete described functions before declaring supported negative.

labeler.rationale: The brief description identifies a conventional lease and contract management software category, but gives no details beyond the category name; non-AI is the best-supported forced judgment.

blind.rationale: The short description identifies lease and contract management software but provides no further functional detail. Best-supported is a conventional management tool, though the sparse text limits confidence in ruling out AI functionality.

description: Instant Access to Market Trends, Company & Industry Intelligence and Performance.

labeler.rationale: The text names market trends, company and industry intelligence, and performance information but offers little functional detail; it supports a conventional information service only weakly, so this is a forced non-AI judgment.
evidence_spans: Instant Access to Market Trends, Company & Industry Intelligence and Performance.

blind.rationale: The phrase indicates access to market trends, company/industry intelligence and performance information, a conventional information/market-intelligence offering; its brevity leaves details unclear, so the negative is weak.
evidence_spans: Instant Access to Market Trends, Company & Industry Intelligence and Performance.

description: Leading global software provider empowering business and IT users with agile data management productivity tools to make SAP systems easier for every user.

labeler.rationale: Describes agile data-management productivity tools intended to make SAP systems easier to use, a conventional data-management and usability function.
evidence_spans: agile data management productivity tools to make SAP systems easier for every user.

blind.rationale: The stated function is agile data-management productivity tooling that makes SAP systems easier to use, conventional data-management and usability functionality without an AI signal.
evidence_spans: agile data management productivity tools to make SAP systems easier for every user.

parent_concerns: Agile data-management productivity tools and making SAP easier may state a category/benefit, not concrete operations. Do not infer usability or data-handling functions beyond text; assess support.

description: Adobe Target is a personalization solution that makes it easy to identify your best content through tests that are easy to execute. So you can deliver the right experience to the right customer.

labeler.rationale: The description specifies personalization through tests to identify content and deliver customer experiences; it does not describe learned or AI-based methods.
evidence_spans: a personalization solution that makes it easy to identify your best content through tests that are easy to execute. So you can deliver the right experience to the right customer.

blind.rationale: The description specifies personalization through tests to identify preferred content and deliver customer experiences; it does not establish AI, and testing/personalization can be conventional.
evidence_spans: a personalization solution that makes it easy to identify your best content through tests that are easy to execute.

parent_concerns: Personalization and choosing best content/right customer through tests could be conventional testing or AI-driven targeting. Text gives no test/selection mechanism. Address whether AI-dependent personalization remains unresolved; no product knowledge or inference from absence of AI words.

description:
ABC lease optimization software, our flagship product, is renowned for optimizing intricately structured financial transactions and comparing financial alternatives.  It supports many types of analysis, including leveraged and direct leases, partnerships, inverted leases, operating leases, lease versus buy, sell/lease back versus retain, project finance, debt and revenue optimization, securitization, and portfolio analysis.
Now Accuty Analytics.

labeler.rationale: The software performs financial lease optimization and comparison across specified transaction and portfolio analyses, conventional financial modeling and analysis.
evidence_spans: optimizing intricately structured financial transactions and comparing financial alternatives.  It supports many types of analysis, including leveraged and direct leases, partnerships, inverted leases, operating leases, lease versus buy, sell/lease back versus retain, project finance, debt and revenue optimization, securitization, and portfolio analysis.

blind.rationale: The product is described for comparing financial alternatives and analyzing lease, debt, revenue and portfolio structures, conventional financial modeling and analysis functions without an AI signal.
evidence_spans: optimizing intricately structured financial transactions and comparing financial alternatives.  It supports many types of analysis, including leveraged and direct leases, partnerships, inverted leases, operating leases, lease versus buy, sell/lease back versus retain, project finance, debt and revenue optimization, securitization, and portfolio analysis.

parent_concerns: Lease/debt/revenue optimization and financial alternatives analysis do not state mechanism. Assess whether conventional financial comparison suffices or optimization remains potentially AI-dependent; do not assume mathematical/modeling implementation.
